title: flow-agents.stop-gate-summary
description: Machine-derived stop-gate cross-check summary (flow-agents #1266). One JSON line per Stop-gate evaluation, appended to .kontourai/telemetry/stop-gate-summary.jsonl by scripts/hooks/stop-goal-fit.js (best-effort local record, #1087 slice C class; the latest row per session slug is that session's close reading). Every number is observed from the gate's single truth source — captureCrossReference + capturedFailReconciliation — never recomputed. This is the machine-derived counterpart to the economics record's SELF-REPORTED defects.caught_false_completions; the two must not be conflated. Absent hooks/session ⇒ absent record: a session the gate never cross-referenced emits no row, never a fabricated zero row.

at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of this Stop-gate evaluation.

session.description: Session artifact directory basename (slug) the gate scoped to.

blocking.description: Whether this evaluation blocked the stop. Counts report what was OBSERVED regardless of enforcement mode; this field reports enforcement. A row with claims_contradicted > 0 and blocking:false means the gate was in warn mode or the block released.

commands_captured.description: DISTINCT NORMALIZED COMMANDS in the capture log — the size of readLatestCommandLog's latest-wins map — NOT raw command-log.jsonl entries. A command re-run five times counts once.

claims_total.description: Every claimed-pass command check the gate derived (trust.bundle-authoritative when a bundle exists, else evidence.json sidecar claims).

claims_checked.description: Claimed-pass checks the cross-reference actually examined. The gate caps at 8 (claimedPass.slice(0, 8) in stop-goal-fit.js) — claims_total vs claims_checked is mandatory so zero-contradicted is NEVER readable as full coverage. The maximum here is deliberately pinned to the code's cap; if the cap changes, this schema must change with it.

claims_confirmed_from_capture.description: Bundle claims deterministically confirmed by an intact (chain-not-broken) capture record showing a clean pass: no failure, no ambiguity, no exit-code laundering, no undisclosed test-scope narrowing, no provenance issue. Narrowed-but-passing and provenance-flagged claims are NOT confirmed.

claims_contradicted.description: Contradictions merged from BOTH sources — captureCrossReference (capture-log FAIL contradicting a claimed pass, or a trusted-backstop re-run FAIL) and capturedFailReconciliation (namespace-agnostic Case A) — deduplicated by normalized command so one contradiction is one count, mirroring analyze()'s bundleEnforcement warning dedup. Laundered-pass and ambiguous captures are NOT_VERIFIED classes and never counted here. Counts contradictions from captureCrossReference and capturedFailReconciliation only; bundleEnforcement's tampered/disputed catches are deliberately excluded, so a blocking stop can carry claims_contradicted: 0 when the catch was a bundle-tamper rather than a command contradiction.

backstop_reruns.description: Trusted backstop re-runs that actually executed this evaluation (a backstop that failed to start is not counted).

chain.description: verifyCommandLogChain's REAL enum, unmapped. `legacy` means NO hash chain exists (pre-B2 log or no log) and must never be rendered as verified; `forked` is a benign concurrent-append race; `broken` means the capture truth source appears tampered and pass signals were not trusted.
